The film is a black comedy that satirizes the superhero genre, and Washington's portrayal of the sullen, alcohol-addled hero is one of the central performances, paired with his on-screen daughter (played by Zach Galifianakis) and the earnest attempted redemption by his partner, Mary Harahan.
